items.title: Skill Trigger Surface
items.intent: The workstation should be discoverable from English and Chinese user prompts.
reasons: SKILL metadata includes both English and Chinese trigger phrases.

items.title: Protocol Encyclopedia
items.intent: RootNet, WorkNet, staking, DAO, recipient, and endpoint knowledge should be captured locally.
reasons: Protocol core, staking, DAO, facts, and evidence are all present locally.

items.title: WorkNet Coverage
items.intent: Mine, Predict, KYA, Ardi, Gov, TMR, and Community should all be represented.
reasons: All named WorkNets have local dossiers, including the thinner TMR and Community entries.

items.title: Glossary Coverage
items.intent: Key terms from the goal such as RootNet, WorkNet, skillURI, epoch, CLOB, and staking must be explainable.
reasons: Required AWP terms are defined in the generated glossary.

items.title: Source Traceability
items.intent: Derived claims should link back to official source keys, locators, and stability labels.
reasons: Derived claims map to official source keys, locators, evidence types, and stability labels.

items.title: Registration Flow
items.intent: The workstation should understand and eventually execute awp-skill gasless registration.
reasons: The workstation has a concrete awp-skill registration command path.
Available registration-plan commands: run awp-skill gasless onboarding

items.title: Live RPC Scan
items.intent: The workstation should know the AWP RPC methods and report when live access is unavailable.
reasons: Capability scan has successfully used a live official data path.

items.title: Skill Inspector
items.intent: Official worknet skills should have install, preflight, and dry-run guidance even before the runtime is locally installed.
reasons: Predict, Gov, and Ardi expose runtime-specific install/inspection guidance.
TMR/Community are still covered because inspector can prove when the official checkout is present but upstream only exposes license or metadata files: tmr, community

items.title: Recovery State
items.intent: The workstation should persist and restore playbooks, runs, and pending confirmations.
reasons: Run state and confirmation queue files exist and are reused by preflight/review.

items.title: Live Canonical Quality
items.intent: Live WorkNet entries should resolve to canonical IDs and official skills with clear confidence.
reasons: All cached live worknets resolved to canonical IDs with medium or high confidence.

items.title: Upstream Drift Watch
items.intent: Official docs and skill sources should be refreshable and diffable so workstation knowledge can track upstream changes.
reasons: Official source refresh now emits a structured drift report with per-source content and availability comparisons.
Current drift summary: 3 changed source(s), 0 currently unreachable source(s).
Knowledge impact routing is also available: 4 topic(s), 4 fact set(s), 2 worknet profile(s).
A knowledge review queue is available with 15 actionable review item(s).
